procedure: Run identical fixtures on both versions. Preserve prior correctness labels for identical replies and citations. Review every changed reply against its citation. The known misses guided this change. The quality fixture still attributes the Magic Belt threat to Ozma in its first question. The first-turn score keeps the previous review’s correction for that attribution.
